messages.text:
here's a random idea that would drive a TON of engagement if we can thread the needle

I'm sure you've seen Apple released 'live events' on your lock screen recently (sports scores, uber rides, flights, etc).  I love the feature from an engagement perspective as its on your home screen before you even unlock your phone (we used this at WW to track points)
<https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/live-activities/>

what we could do is a set a 'expiration' of your daily digest - so the live event loads every day when your algo is refreshed, and until you complete your daily digest it doesnt dismiss, has. We could even do a countdown timer to when the algo updates "you have 2hours 32 mins left to see today's news'

Would be buzzy and we could build a whole campaign around it

not sure if this came up on the radar or not but figured i'd throw it out there

attachments.title: Live Activities | Apple Developer Documentation
attachments.text: A Live Activity lets people track the progress of an activity, event, or task at a glance.

messages.text:
just passing this along - i got a notification to 'pin the live score' of the yankee game to my iphone home screen from Google - absolutely genius - the push message redirected to this screen  - i hit Pin Live Score - it sent me to settings, and boom - i had it on my phone screen.

I really do think this would kill for forming that early habit on the customer to 'keep up with the news each day'

figured i'd pass along
